name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-plugin-retirement-radar
title: Retirement Radar for Copilot Cowork
shortDescription: A Cowork plugin that checks Microsoft technologies for deprecation and retirement using live Microsoft Learn documentation.
longDescription: Retirement Radar inspects scripts, application code, configuration files, dependency lists, and architecture notes for retired or deprecated Microsoft technologies.
The plugin uses an agent skill and the public Microsoft Learn MCP server to produce sourced findings, supported replacements, code suggestions, and prioritized migration checklists.
